implementation.targetScope: Independent TeX parsing/layout for web math and complete problem PNG/SVG composition: prose, paragraphs, ordered figures, arrays, choice grids and bounded PNG validation.

fontData.approach: Selected numeric glyph metrics with an interned SVG outline pool, reproducibly extracted to JSON. No upstream executable code ships with the math engine.

optionalRasterizer.role: Existing native SVG-to-PNG engine, not a TeX parser or layout implementation.

changes: One independent syntax tree and layout for web and image output; no engine routing or fallback.
Explicit unsupported syntax, finite input/recursion/expansion/pixel bounds and request-local macros.
Generated font data retains upstream attribution and reproducible extraction.
Expanded notation, styled text, primes, font variants, spanning table cells and scoped colors against actual caller requirements.
Independent 960px page composition using shared outlines/layout and vpngjs figure validation; 28 unchanged application picture tests pass.
All 8470 math spans and 1275 normalized full statements render in the audited 89-file local corpus; this is not a production-wide or visual-equivalence claim.
Browser HTML inherits theme and font size, honors forced system colors and keeps enlarged equations within local scroll bounds.
Optional DOM lifecycle adds tab stops only for overflow, selected-TeX copying, replacement observation and owned-attribute cleanup.
Chrome visual/accessibility-tree gate verifies 53 formulas, reading structure, phantom exclusion, zoom/reflow and real keyboard scrolling. This is not a claim of actual screen-reader acceptance.
Validate font-size/display options before cache lookup; invalid non-finite sizes cannot collide with the inherited-size cache entry.

Add contest congruence, similarity, divisibility and slanted inequality commands with relation spacing; single-symbol negation uses dedicated glyphs or a visible strike with MathML combining negation. Verified against KaTeX and MathJax controls.

The November 3 production snapshot has zero VLX-only failures among 99184 KaTeX-accepted expressions; 451 baseline-rejected inputs are tracked separately. Only aggregate evidence and synthetic regressions are public.

Add production-used line breaks, class wrappers, delimiter aliases, continued/infix fractions, annotations, text commands, rule geometry and glyphs; semantic controls also verify the black lozenge symbol.
Optional React 19 components defer renderer/glyph loading, isolate errors per formula and own DOM cleanup. Core rendering stays synchronous and React-free.
CSS scale and centered display hooks; scroll focus requires actual usable overflow and handles scaled formulas and missing window observers.
Intern repeated font paths: expanded glyph coverage uses 784343 bytes instead of 896594 bytes in r2. Bold symbols retain italic letter shapes, including nested italic text.

After verified source repairs to 165 statements, two rubrics and 94 answer/choice values, all 99635 audited expressions render. Slanted roman text, crossed-o letters and bounded array spacing remain supported; formula-only input rejects outer delimiters, legacy aliases and corrupt control characters.
Fitting/hidden formulas skip computed-style reads; forced-colors rules are installed once per document or imported as static CSS.
Preloaded React renders immediately, with inherited provider defaults for scroll labels and loading fallbacks.

React creates native SVG and MathML elements from the shared layout, with no HTML parsing or insertion. String and image outputs use an escaped string emitter over the same geometry rules. Fixed glyph outlines are shared from the finite font pool.

114 inline/display fixtures preserve r6 geometry and canonical DOM/SSR structure. Native Chrome controls verify MathML roles, visual bounds, shared oblique/forced-colors styling and Trusted Types without an HTML policy. Lazy/preloaded mounts and changed/unchanged updates retain formula nodes.

acceptance.remainingWork: Actual VoiceOver/Safari and NVDA/Chrome speech/navigation checks and WebKit/Firefox visual acceptance. VentiMath frontend already consumes r7; Discord problem-image migration from MathJax remains a separate backend integration task.
acceptance.scopeLimits: Arbitrary TeX packages, advanced macro programming and automatic equation references are outside the verified application scope.
